headline: Nvidia Approaches Arm CEO Rene Haas in Search for Next Leader
summary: Nvidia headhunters have approached Arm CEO Rene Haas as a leading contender to replace Jensen Huang following his exit, according to reports.
why: Nvidia is the world's most valuable semiconductor designer, while Arm provides the foundational chip architecture used by billions of devices and major hyperscalers globally.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Uncertainty or transition in Nvidia's executive leadership directly influences investor sentiment and governance outlook.
